text:
Why I won't buy Anthropic stocks

If you don't believe in AI will be smarter than human, there is NO WAY they can turn a profit.

If you believe AI will be smarter than human, the AI's goal is to build the next gen, its incentive is NOT making money for the human shareholders.

Read the article for the full argument. I spend a lot of time chatting back and forth with GPT to come up with this conclusion. I spent the tokens, might as well share what I learn.
